title: Personalized Baseball Bedding Full Size Flag Custom Name D - Design 19
description:
Embrace your passion for baseball with this dynamic Jeminise Comforter Set, perfect for adding a personalized touch to any sports enthusiast's bedroom. Designed for comfort and style, this bedding set celebrates the spirit of the game with a custom design.

Key Features

  • Meaningful Gift: An ideal present for baseball players, fans, and lovers, celebrating determination and sport.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin, US Full, US Queen, and US King to fit various bed dimensions.
  • Superior Manufacturing Process: Environmentally friendly finishing prevents dye fading, ensuring long-lasting vibrancy.
  • Soft & Comfy Material: Made from 100% Brushed Polyester Fabric with Whole-Piece Microfiber Filling for a soft, durable, and lightweight feel.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water and suitable for air drying without heat, making maintenance simple.
  • Custom Options: Features text input for personalization, allowing for a unique touch.
  • Design Theme: Showcases a vibrant Baseball Thunder pattern with a Fire Baseball Player design.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester, Cotton
Fill Material Microfiber Filling
Color Baseball Thunder
Pattern Baseball
Set Name Personalized Baseball Bedding Set
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Special Feature Breathable
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Customization 2 text inputs
Thread Count 400
Included Components Duvet Cover
Number of Items 1
Pillowcase Quantity 2
Closure Type Zipper
